Audit kb tool: Backend & Frontend Architecture Review
Backend Architecture: Harman-style Action Registry, strict receipt error isolation, JSONL persistence
Frontend Architecture: Modular React view components, lazy-loaded Canvas/Graph, Zustand stores, optimistic mutations
Actionable Improvements: Add React Error Boundaries around lazy subviews; localize text save rollback
Interactive HTML Walkthrough: tools/kb/kb-code-walkthrough.html
Backend: Decouple surface/ui.ts (HTTP/WS Router vs FS Subscription Hub)
Problem: ui.ts (633 LOC) combines HTTP API routing, WebSocket upgrade & client tracking, static asset serving, saved query loading, and FSWatcher on .kb/nodes.jsonl.
Fix: Extract ui/server.ts for HTTP/WS routing and ui/watcher.ts for SubscriptionHub & FS event debouncing.
Impact: Localizes watcher errors and static file 404 handling so they cannot interfere with transaction broadcasting.
Backend: Move DataScript EDN Queries out of surface/map.ts
Problem: CLI mapping helpers mapFieldList() and mapTagList() hardcode raw EDN datalog query strings inside the CLI surface mapper.
Fix: Move standard EDN queries into foundation/query/queries.ts.
Impact: Decouples CLI flag parsing from datalog query syntax changes.
Frontend: Add React Error Boundaries around Lazy-Loaded Views
Problem: CanvasPage and GraphPage in App.tsx are lazy-loaded with <Suspense> but lack localized <ErrorBoundary> wrappers.
Fix: Wrap <Suspense> fallback routes in App.tsx with a lightweight <ErrorBoundary fallback={<ViewError />}>.
Impact: WebGL/Canvas runtime crashes remain contained within the viewport while header chrome and sidebar stay interactive.
Frontend: Localize Debounced Text Revert Scope in mutations.ts
Problem: mutations.updateNodeContent() captures full wireNodes snapshot; server POST failure triggers resyncOrRestore() which re-hydrates the entire graph.
Fix: Scope optimistic rollback state to the specific node ID being edited.
Impact: Preserves concurrent edits on other nodes if a single debounced text save fails.

Walkthrough freshness audit (2026-08-10)
Status: the prior kb-code-walkthrough.html was stale
The earlier walkthrough described the pre-Effect backend and the old monolithic surface/ui.ts. The repository has since changed materially.
The HTML walkthrough was refreshed at tools/kb/kb-code-walkthrough.html with clickable file:// and vscode:// paths plus current code excerpts.
Backend current state: Effect is now in use
tools/kb/package.json now depends on effect 4.0.0-beta.106 and @effect/platform-bun.
foundation/services.ts defines KbCtx, KbStore, bunFileSystemLayer, kbRuntimeLayer, openKbEffect, reloadEffect, persistEffect, and Promise compatibility facades.
Core operations and registry invocation are Effect-native; third-party extensions may still use the legacy Promise handler path.
Action failures remain localized at the ActionReceipt boundary through typed Effect/domain errors and receipt mapping.
Backend modularization current state
surface/ui.ts is now a stable facade, not the server implementation.
surface/ui/server.ts owns Bun.serve lifecycle, WebSocket transport callbacks, fs-watch lifecycle, and production/dev orchestration.
surface/ui/http.ts owns Effect REST/API routing and failure mapping.
surface/ui/session.ts owns SubscriptionHub, client tracking, tx broadcasts, query subscriptions, and virtual saved-query nodes.
surface/ui/assets.ts, build.ts, dev.ts, saved-queries.ts, and paths.ts isolate asset serving, build checks, Vite orchestration, saved queries, and path constants.
Query boundary current state
Standard DataScript query strings now live in foundation/query/queries.ts: LIST_FIELDS_QUERY, LIST_TAGS_QUERY, LIST_ALL_NODES_QUERY, and backlinksQuery().
surface/map.ts imports those constants and remains a CLI flag-to-action adapter.
Frontend current state
The frontend remains React plus Zustand; Effect was not added to the browser bundle.
App.tsx lazy-loads Graph and Canvas chunks and wraps each in ViewErrorBoundary so a view crash does not take down shell chrome.
actions/mutations.ts uses per-node preEdit state for debounced text writes; failed resync restores only the failed node and reapplies pending local edits.

actions/optimistic.ts performs bounded recovery for partial plans: refetch first, then removes minted nodes, restores touched nodes, reapplies confirmed non-structural actions, preserves unrelated concurrent edits, and keeps revision monotonic.
kb-ui process failure and recovery
Observed: supervised process kb-ui failed with exit code 1 after its earlier listening state.
The retained kb-ui log exposed only the earlier listening line and no root-cause diagnostic; no cause is inferred.
Recovery: a fresh process named kb-ui-current was started successfully on http://127.0.0.1:4321 and the root endpoint returned HTTP 200.
